stem: Which sentence from the selection best conveys the author’s main message?

options.label: A
options.text: But as mentally prepared as we were, we also had to be physically aware, as well. (paragraph 6)

options.label: B
options.text: Every night aboard our safe and warm ship, we thought about what it takes to survive in Antarctica, an incredibly harsh place. (paragraph 19)

options.label: C
options.text: Over the course of our visit, we came to respect and even revere the power of that sea. (paragraph 20)

options.label: D
options.text: Both experiences were unforgettable, and one would not have been possible without the other. (paragraph 21)
